item.title: a word of unusual size
item.dc:creator: mathNEWS
item.content:encoded:
one abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabc is twenty-nine, below the body threshold abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcd is thirty, exactly the body threshold abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcde is thirty-one, one over the body threshold abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdef is thirty-two, two over the body threshold Pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosisandthensome is fifty-six, a lot over chocolate/cappuccinos is twenty-one, and stays whole in body text 1234567890123456789012345678901234567890 is a forty character number Donaudampfschifffahrtsgesellschaftskapitän has a non-ascii character abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcd. is thirty-one only because of its period, so it cannot break abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefghi. is thirty-six, and must not break before its period abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefgh!? must not break before either of its last two characters (abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefg) counts its brackets, but will not break before the last one !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! is thirty-six characters of pure punctuation abcdefghijklmnoabcdefghijklmnopqrst is thirty-five across an em tag abcdefghijabcdefghijabcdefghijklmno is thirty-five across three tags abcdefghijabcdefghijklmno is only twenty-five across an em tag, so it is left alone

abcdefghijklmnopqrst is split by a line break, not an inline tag www.anextremelylongdomainnamethatgoesonandon.com is recognised as a link https://example.org/a/very/long/path/indeed keeps its scheme and stays whole arxiv.org/abs/2401.12345v2 and bit.ly/averylongshortenedlink have no scheme someone.withaverylongname@uwaterloo.ca is an email address https://example.org/a/long/path is a URL split across an em tag an anchor tag whose abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefghi is left alone http://mathnews.uwaterloo.ca/issue/v1xxiy/a-long-article-slug is a URL whose first half is recognised as a link text anchorabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefghijklmn is a long word glued to anchor text, so it counts as part of the link and stays whole example.net/a/long/path/the/old/regex/missed is recognised now that the TLD list is fixed notaurl.butaverylongwordindeedyes only looks a little like a domain a footnote[1] [1] https://example.org/a/very/long/footnoted/url
